# Crocco Painting & Venetian

> Crocco Painting & Venetian provides residential and commercial painting, Venetian plaster, decorative finishes and colour consultation across Melbourne and South East Melbourne, Australia.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://croccopainting.com.au/): Painting and decorative finish services, gallery and quote enquiry form.
- [About](https://croccopainting.com.au/about.html): Business background, team and credentials.

## Services

- [Residential painting](https://croccopainting.com.au/residential.html): Interior and exterior home painting, repaints, preparation and colour guidance.
- [Commercial painting](https://croccopainting.com.au/commercial.html): Painting for workplaces, retail, hospitality and commercial properties.
- [Venetian plaster](https://croccopainting.com.au/venetian-plaster.html): Handcrafted plaster and decorative finishes for residential and commercial interiors.
